# ADR-3248: AWS s3: Cross-account get without condition for bucket 8

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Unconditional cross-account gets overshare.

## Decision

Shares MUST NOT allow a cross-account get without condition for bucket 8 (AWS-s3-8) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Conditions bind org ID or VPC endpoints.
